title: UN Chief Issues Final Warning as COP31 Summit Reaches Critical Stage
subtitle: António Guterres calls for urgent action, stating that global peace and climate stability are inseparable.

summary.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres delivered an emotional final address at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey. He warned that the world cannot achieve peace while the planet continues to warm. The summit is now moving toward final negotiations on energy and finance. Leaders are discussing targets for electricity and reducing fossil fuel use. Guterres urged his successor to keep the climate crisis at the top of the global agenda.
summary.zh: 聯合國秘書長古特瑞斯在土耳其舉行的COP31氣候峰會上發表了感性的告別演說。他警告，在地球持續暖化的情況下，世界無法實現和平。目前峰會正進入能源與財政議題的最後談判階段，各國領袖正在討論電力目標與減少化石燃料使用的相關事宜。古特瑞斯敦促其繼任者將氣候危機置於全球議程的首位。

paragraphs.en: As the COP31 climate summit in Turkey reaches its final days, the outgoing UN Secretary-General, António Guterres, has issued a powerful final warning to world leaders. In an emotional farewell speech, Guterres stated that the climate crisis is not just an environmental issue, but a central challenge that affects every part of human life. He warned that "you cannot build peace on a burning planet," emphasizing that climate disasters constantly undo progress in fighting poverty and creating stability.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著在土耳其舉行的第31屆聯合國氣候變遷大會（COP31）進入尾聲，即將卸任的聯合國秘書長古特瑞斯（António Guterres）向各國領袖發出了強而有力的最後警告。古特瑞斯在感性的告別演說中表示，氣候危機不僅僅是環境問題，更是影響人類生活各個層面的核心挑戰。他警告說：「在一個燃燒的星球上，無法建立和平。」並強調氣候災難不斷抵銷人類在消除貧困與創造穩定方面所取得的進展。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, Guterres has been one of the most direct leaders on the subject of climate change during his time in office. As he prepares to leave his role at the end of December, he used his final press conference to urge the international community to face the facts. He argued that climate change drives anger, causes people to lose their homes, and makes competition for land and water much worse. For Guterres, climate action is not simply one of many issues; it is a fundamental part of the United Nations' work.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，古特瑞斯在任期內一直是氣候變遷議題上最直言不諱的領導人之一。隨著他準備在十二月底卸下職務，他利用最後一場記者會敦促國際社會正視事實。他主張氣候變遷會引發憤怒、導致人們流離失所，並加劇對土地與水資源的爭奪。對古特瑞斯而言，氣候行動不僅是眾多議題中的一項，更是聯合國工作的根本核心。

paragraphs.en: Most of the world leaders who attended the summit have already returned to their home countries, leaving negotiators to work on the final details of the meeting. These negotiations are expected to result in a "cover decision," which is the final document that summarizes the agreements made during the summit. According to The Guardian, this document will likely include goals for the electrification of the global economy, as well as plans to help developing countries that are hit hardest by climate disasters.
paragraphs.zh: 大多數出席峰會的各國領袖已經返回各自國家，留下談判代表處理會議的最後細節。這些談判預計將產生一份「總結決議」，這是一份概述峰會期間所達成協議的最終文件。根據《衛報》報導，該文件可能會納入全球經濟電氣化的目標，以及協助受氣候災難打擊最嚴重的開發中國家的計畫。

paragraphs.en: One of the main goals for this year’s summit is to reach a target where 35% of the world’s final energy comes from electricity by 2035. This is seen as a key step in moving away from fossil fuels, which are energy sources like coal, oil, and gas that release harmful gases into the atmosphere. The Australian co-presidency of the summit has been working to turn the proposals discussed throughout the week into a formal agreement. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese spent his time at the talks focusing on the needs of Pacific nations, which are particularly vulnerable to rising sea levels and extreme weather.
paragraphs.zh: 今年峰會的主要目標之一，是達成在2035年時全球最終能源有35%來自電力的目標。這被視為擺脫化石燃料的關鍵一步，化石燃料是指煤炭、石油和天然氣等會向大氣排放有害氣體的能源。擔任峰會共同主席國的澳洲一直致力於將整週討論的提案轉化為正式協議。澳洲總理艾班尼斯（Anthony Albanese）在會談期間將重點放在太平洋島國的需求上，這些國家特別容易受到海平面上升與極端氣候的影響。

paragraphs.en: Despite the progress, the road ahead remains difficult. Guterres noted that there is a wide gap between what science demands and what politicians are currently willing to deliver. He criticized the influence of the fossil fuel industry, stating that the future of the planet should not be decided by those who profit from its destruction. He also addressed concerns about his successor, as there is fear that the next UN leader might downplay the climate crisis to focus on other political issues.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有所進展，前方的道路依然艱難。古特瑞斯指出，科學界的要求與政治人物目前願意提供的承諾之間存在巨大鴻溝。他批評了化石燃料產業的影響力，並表示地球的未來不應由那些從破壞地球中獲利的人來決定。他也針對繼任者的相關疑慮發表了看法，因為外界擔心下一任聯合國領導人可能會淡化氣候危機，轉而關注其他政治議題。

paragraphs.en: Looking forward, the success of COP31 will depend on whether countries can agree on clear, actionable steps. Previous summits have set important precedents, such as the 2023 pledge in Dubai to transition away from fossil fuels and the 2021 agreement in Glasgow to "phase down" the use of coal. A phase-down is a process of gradually reducing the use of something until it is no longer the primary source. Negotiators at COP31 hope to build on these foundations by securing better financial support for poorer nations and making stronger commitments to cut methane emissions.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，COP31的成功將取決於各國能否就明確且可執行的步驟達成共識。過去的峰會已樹立了重要的先例，例如2023年在杜拜做出的轉型脫離化石燃料的承諾，以及2021年在格拉斯哥達成的「逐步減少」煤炭使用的協議。「逐步減少」是一個逐漸降低某種事物的使用量，直到它不再是主要來源的過程。COP31的談判代表希望在這些基礎上，為貧窮國家爭取更好的財政支持，並做出更強有力的承諾以削減甲烷排放。

paragraphs.en: As the summit draws to a close, the message from the UN chief remains clear: the world is on a dangerous path, and only by following the science can humanity hope to secure a better future. Guterres encouraged civil society and governments to keep pushing for change, even when the truth is uncomfortable. He reminded the audience that his responsibility was never to make the facts easier to accept, but to tell the truth as it is. As the delegates finalize their agreements, the world is watching to see if these promises will lead to real, lasting change for the planet.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著峰會接近尾聲，聯合國秘書長的訊息依然明確：世界正處於危險的道路上，唯有遵循科學，人類才有望確保更美好的未來。古特瑞斯鼓勵公民社會與政府持續推動變革，即使真相令人不適。他提醒聽眾，他的責任從來不是讓事實變得更容易接受，而是如實陳述真相。當代表們完成協議的最終定稿時，全世界都在關注這些承諾是否會為地球帶來真正且持久的改變。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cancel out or reverse the effects of something that has already been done.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 抵銷、抹煞、使（努力或進展）化為烏有。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「解開」（如鞋帶），這裡指消除或破壞已取得的成果。文中：Guterres stated that the climate crisis is not just an environmental issue, but a central challenge that affects every part of human life. He warned that "you cannot build peace on a burning planet," emphasizing that climate disasters constantly undo progress in fighting poverty and creating stability.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cause something to happen or develop, especially something negative.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 驅使、導致、促使（通常指負面事物）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「駕駛」，這裡指導致某種負面情緒或現象的產生。文中：He argued that climate change drives anger, causes people to lose their homes, and makes competition for land and water much worse.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make something seem less important or serious than it really is.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 對……輕描淡寫、淡化、貶低……的重要性。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 down 和 play 組成，字面意思容易誤解，實際指刻意降低某事的嚴重性。文中：He also addressed concerns about his successor, as there is fear that the next UN leader might downplay the climate crisis to focus on other political issues.

quiz.question: What specific target regarding energy does the COP31 summit aim to achieve by 2035?

options.A: A complete cessation of all fossil fuel extraction worldwide.
options.B: Ensuring that 35% of the world's final energy consumption is derived from electricity.
options.C: Reducing methane emissions by 35% compared to 2021 levels.
options.D: Transitioning 35% of the global economy to renewable energy sources.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段第一句，會議的主要目標之一是達成「35% of the world’s final energy comes from electricity by 2035」。選項 A 錯誤，因為文中僅提到「離開化石燃料」，並未要求立即完全停止開採；選項 C 混淆了數據，文中提到甲烷減排是目標之一，但未指定 35% 為其目標；選項 D 將「電氣化」誤解為「再生能源」，雖然兩者相關，但並非文中定義的 35% 目標內容。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the transition to a greener economy be politically challenging for some nations?

options.A: Because developing nations are currently refusing to sign any climate agreements.
options.B: Because the UN Secretary-General has decided to step down from his position.
options.C: Because there is a conflict between scientific necessity and the political willingness to act.
options.D: Because the Australian co-presidency has failed to organize the summit effectively.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，古特雷斯提到「there is a wide gap between what science demands and what politicians are currently willing to deliver」，這暗示了科學上的急迫性與政治決策間的落差，這是推動環保政策困難的主因。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 B 雖然是事實，但與政治挑戰無直接因果關係；選項 D 與事實不符，文中並未指責澳洲主辦方無能。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'the truth as it is' imply in the context of Guterres's leadership?

options.A: Presenting facts without softening them to make them more palatable.
options.B: The ability to predict future climate events with absolute certainty.
options.C: Changing his personal opinions to match the majority of world leaders.
options.D: Focusing exclusively on the positive progress made during the summit.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到「his responsibility was never to make the facts easier to accept, but to tell the truth as it is」，這代表他選擇誠實面對氣候危機的嚴峻性，而不為了討好他人而美化事實。選項 B 錯誤，科學無法提供絕對預測；選項 C 與古特雷斯強調的立場相反；選項 D 錯誤，他反而強調了氣候危機的危險路徑，而非僅談論進展。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the COP31 climate summit?

options.A: The summit has successfully solved the global climate crisis through new agreements.
options.B: The UN Secretary-General is retiring to focus on local environmental issues.
options.C: The summit highlights the urgent need for global action and scientific adherence despite political obstacles.
options.D: The primary focus of the summit was to debate the future of the Australian government.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文核心在於古特雷斯對氣候危機的警告，以及 COP31 會議在科學需求與政治執行力之間尋求平衡的過程，強調必須採取實際行動。選項 A 過於樂觀，文中指出路途仍艱難；選項 B 偏離主題，古特雷斯的退休只是背景；選項 D 錯誤，澳洲總理的參與只是會議的一小部分，並非核心議題。
